sourceChecked.found: the issuer's address table, row "OP Mainnet"

confirmation.residualRisk: settle: a sequencer reorganisation deeper than 5 blocks (about 10 s) after the page showed a result; the page then shows an outcome that the chain replaced, the transaction is still valid and is normally included again; no second transaction is created by the page. strict: the chain's finalized tag (batch final on Ethereum), no residual beyond the endpoint's honesty.

reserveCapsReason: No caps (coordinator's technical decision, 2026-11-17): an ordinary constant-product exchange. The caps exist on the Bloch L2 to bound what a fault of the bridge can drain through a pool of a bridged asset; the assets listed here are the chain's own native coin and a token issued on this chain, so that risk does not exist, and a pool capped on both sides would leak its fees to whoever calls skim first (docs/MULTICHAIN-DEPLOY.md section 2).

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 0.1 ETH and its USDC at the market price: gas is negligible here (the first deposit cost under 0.001 ETH in every measurement); the floor keeps the pool worth more than a few hundred dollars a side, below which a 100-dollar swap moves the price by tens of percent and the page's quotes are of no use. Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.
